name: FileOpenWin32
signature: DWORD FileOpenWin32(const wchar_t* path, u32 mode, HANDLE* out, i64* size, ...)
description: archive/file layer open: mode&3 = 1 read (GENERIC_READ, share FILE_SHARE_READ only), 2 write, 3 rw (share 0); dwFlags = (mode & 0x200) << 21 | 0x80 = FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL + optional FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED; never NO_BUFFERING / SEQUENTIAL_SCAN / RANDOM_ACCESS; then GetFileSizeEx + GetFileTime; only caller FileObjOpen 3134F0

name: FileOpenWin32_OverlappedFlagAnd
description: 25 00 02 00 00: selects FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED from open-mode bit 0x200 (then shl eax,15h; bts eax,7); SH design site (imm -> 0 = synchronous handles)

name: FileOpenWin32_CreateFileW
description: FF 15 -> IAT 38E2378; RC registration site (returned handle, access, share)

name: FileObjOpen
description: builds "%s%s" (fs root + name), '/' -> '\\', passes the open mode from [f+30h]+10h to FileOpenWin32 314144; called from FsRequestDispatch 1A77574

name: FsRequestDispatch
description: file-system request switch: open (3134F0), stream read (311BFC), redirected read (2F7BE4C); caller 2F7C7E0

name: FileStreamReadStep
signature: i64 FileStreamReadStep(Fs** fs, FileObj* f, u64 max)
description: 2287 B (fragments up to 1984xxx): sync positional ReadFile (OVERLAPPED offset, no event) at 311D17 with the SRW locks released; if [f+28h]&0x40 and the fs read cache [*fs+70h] is live, serves from FsReadCacheLookup first (call 198357C) and inserts after a real read (FsReadCacheInsert); type 1 = FindNextFileW listing; type 2 = custom vtable stream

name: FileReadOverlappedIssue
signature: bool FileReadOverlappedIssue(Req* r, u64 tag, HANDLE h, u64 off, void* buf, u32 n)
description: shared tail inside FileReadAsyncSubmit: overlapped ReadFile at 3130D6 with r's first OVERLAPPED (hEvent = per-request event); ERROR_IO_PENDING = ok, else FileReqWaitAll 312754

name: FileReqWaitAll
description: the completion path of every archive read: WaitForMultipleObjects(<=64 of r's events, bWaitAll=TRUE, INFINITE) at 3127A1, then r+1Ch = 0; no GetOverlappedResult and no Internal poll in the file layer

name: FileReqAlloc
description: allocates a request with nOv OVERLAPPEDs (stride 20h) and creates one manual-reset event per OVERLAPPED with CreateEventA (site 311EE1) every time; events copied into each OVERLAPPED.hEvent; callers 313184 (n = 1), 740144 (n = entry count)

name: FileReqAlloc_CreateEventA
description: FF 15 -> IAT 38E25C8; one kernel event per read, EP (event pool) site

name: FileReqFree
description: waits (FileReqWaitAll) then CloseHandle on each request event (site 311F89) and frees the request; EP return site

name: FileReadBatchSubmit
signature: int FileReadBatchSubmit(Fs* fs, ReadBatch* b, Req** out)
description: FileReqAlloc(n = b+10h entries), fs SRW lock (fs+88h) shared, file lookup 311A10, then FileReadBatchLocked 7401F0; only caller FileReadBatchRebase 490390

name: FileReadBatchRebase
description: adds the archive base offset [p+18h] to every entry offset of a batch, then FileReadBatchSubmit 740144

name: FileReadBatchLocked
description: 269 B: state check under the file SRW lock f+A0h (shared, exclusive if state 1), sets state 4, RELEASES the lock, then FileReadOverlappedBatch 740300 (no lock held across ReadFile; corrects the 2026-10-08 §5 note)

name: FileReadAsyncSubmit
signature: int FileReadAsyncSubmit(File* f, Req* r, ReadArgs* a)
description: archive file layer: state check under SRW lock f+A0h, lock RELEASED before the overlapped ReadFile at 31305A (handle [f+30h]+18h, buf a+18h, len a+20h, offset a+10h, hEvent = request event); ERROR_IO_PENDING = ok

name: FileReadRedirected
description: read through the fs overlay at [*fs+78h] (2F7A678 resolves another file object), then FileReadSyncAt 312D98 on that file's handle

name: FsReadCacheLookup
signature: int FsReadCacheLookup(FsCache* c, const wchar_t* path, u64 off, void* dst, int n)
description: the game's own read cache: MRU list of blocks keyed by path hash (+81Ch) + path string (+1Ch) + [off, off+len); data in a ring (c[0] base, c[4] block size); copies hits, returns bytes served; caches only what was read (no read-ahead)

name: FsReadCacheInsert
description: inserts/merges the bytes of a completed read into FsReadCache blocks (LRU victim by use count, max count c+24h)

name: FsReadCacheIsLive
description: c[0] != 0 under the cache lock

name: FileStreamReadStep_CacheLookupCall
description: E8 -> 2F77A6C inside a FileStreamReadStep fragment; RP counts calls and hits here

name: FileStreamBounceRead
signature: u64 FileStreamBounceRead(Stream* s, ..., u8* dst, u64 off, u64 n)
description: reads n bytes in chunks of [s+40h] through the bounce buffer [s+38h] (FileReadSyncAtOffsetB 325626C per chunk, then memcpy B94250); read count = n / [s+40h]

name: FileStreamReadAt
description: vtable 50908D8 slot: FileStreamBounceRead(s+8, ..., pos s+20h, n), pos += n

name: FileReadWholeByPath
signature: bool FileReadWholeByPath(const wchar_t* path, void* buf, u64 n)
description: opens (Win32OpenReadShared 1FDB78C), one sync ReadFile of n at 1FD9CA3, CloseHandle; used by SaveDataLoadBin (SAVEDATA.BIN); not a load-time site (was CrtReadFd)

name: Win32OpenReadShared
description: CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, OPEN_EXISTING, NORMAL) at 1FDB7BD (was CrtGetOsHandle; it takes a path, not an fd)

name: FileExistsW
description: open read-shared + close

name: SaveDataLoadBin
description: builds "%s\\%llu\\%s\\SAVEDATA.BIN", reads it whole (1FD9C58), handles BACKUP.BIN

name: FileSetTimesByPath
description: CreateFileW(GENERIC_WRITE) + SetFileTime

name: DeviceReadTimed
description: ReadFile with its own event + GetOverlappedResultEx(100 or 5000 ms) + CancelIoEx on timeout (site AF5656); device/pipe I/O, not archives

name: g_WorkerPoolTable_TrySyncCount
description: pool table entry 9 'TrySync' (4B722D0 + 9*18h) +0Ch: thread count after SizeWorkerPools (dump: 3)

name: g_WorkerPoolTable_TrySyncWeight
description: entry 9 +10h weight = 4; count = trunc(12/13 * weight) (PoolBaseForIndex = 12 for pool 9) -> 3; weight 7 -> 6 (TSY design)
